nodes.label: D1 — The style string
nodes.rationale: Uses legacy Static Maps schema (landscape.man_made.building) to produce binary magenta-on-white imagery for trivial thresholding.

nodes.label: D7 — Source arbitration
nodes.rationale: Rendered source is primary; Overpass is fallback. Results are never merged to avoid overlapping 'ghost' duplicates.

nodes.label: D8 — Heights stay assumed
nodes.rationale: Rendered imagery lacks height data; matching to OSM tags is a spatial join risk, so honest defaults are used instead.
